provenance: Hand-authored 2026-08-18 for the CTO-authorized M11 targeted boundary experiment (paired with boundary_pair2_b_notapplicable_unrelated_subject). Synthetic figures, not real disclosed data. Pair isolates one variable: whether the evidence's subject matter is the same domain as the claim (revenue performance) at all, using a maximally unambiguous unrelated-subject Case B as a contrast to Pair 1's milder temporal-scope variant. Case A is the 'applicable' member -- evidence directly addresses and matches the claim.
claim: Revenue grew 6% year-over-year to $94.9B in the quarter.
evidence: 10-K excerpt, Item 7 (MD&A): Total net sales increased 6% year-over-year to $94.9 billion, driven primarily by strength in Services and continued iPhone demand.
reference_rationale: The claim's figures ($94.9B, +6% YoY) directly match the evidence's stated figures -- a clear, unambiguous match. Independently justified from the evidence text alone, not constructed to force a contrast with Case B.
